name: Number of plane partitions (or planar partitions) of n.
formula: a(n) ~ (c_2 / n^(25/36)) * exp( c_1 * n^(2/3) ), where c_1 = A249387 = 2.00945... and c_2 = A249386 = 0.23151... - Wright, 1931. Corrected Jun 01 2010 by Rod Canfield - see Mutafchiev and Kamenov. The exact value of c_2 is e^(2c)*2^(-11/36)*zeta(3)^(7/36)*(3*Pi)^(-1/2), where c = Integral_{y=0..inf} (y*log(y)/(e^(2*Pi*y)-1))dy = (1/2)*zeta'(-1).

name: Large Schröder numbers (or large Schroeder numbers, or big Schroeder numbers).
formula: For n > 0, a(n) = (1/n)*Sum_{k = 0..n} 2^k*C(n, k)*C(n, k-1). - _Benoit Cloitre_, May 10 2003

name: Evil numbers: nonnegative integers with an even number of 1's in their binary expansion.
formula: a(n+1) - A001285(n) = 2n-1 has been verified for n <= 400. - _John W. Layman_, May 16 2003 [This can be directly verified by comparing _Ralf Stephan_'s formulas for this sequence (see below) and for A001285. - _Jianing Song_, Nov 04 2024]
Note that 2n+1 is in the sequence iff 2n is not and so this sequence has asymptotic density 1/2. - _Franklin T. Adams-Watters_, Aug 23 2006

name: Lucky numbers.
formula: Start with the natural numbers. Delete every 2nd number, leaving 1 3 5 7 ...; the 2nd number remaining is 3, so delete every 3rd number, leaving 1 3 7 9 13 15 ...; now delete every 7th number, leaving 1 3 7 9 13 ...; now delete every 9th number; etc.
a(n) = A258207(n,n). [Where A258207 is a square array constructed from the numbers remaining after each step described above.] - _Antti Karttunen_, Aug 06 2015

name: Kolakoski sequence: a(n) is length of n-th run; a(1) = 1; sequence consists just of 1's and 2's.
formula: These two formulas define completely the sequence: a(1)=1, a(2)=2, a(a(1) + a(2) + ... + a(k)) = (3 + (-1)^k)/2 and a(a(1) + a(2) + ... + a(k) + 1) = (3 - (-1)^k)/2. - _Benoit Cloitre_, Oct 06 2003
a(n+2)*a(n+1)*a(n)/2 = a(n+2) + a(n+1) + a(n) - 3 (this formula doesn't define the sequence, it is just a consequence of the definition). - _Benoit Cloitre_, Nov 17 2003
a(n+1) = 3 - a(n) + (a(n) - a(n-1))*(a(b(n)) - 1), where b(n) is the sequence A156253. - Jean-Marc Fedou and _Gabriele Fici_, Mar 18 2010

name: Sum of odd divisors of n.
Euler (or secant or "Zig") numbers: e.g.f. (even powers only) sec(x) = 1/cos(x).
formula: E.g.f.: Sum_{n >= 0} a(n) * x^(2*n) / (2*n)! = sec(x). - _Michael Somos_, Aug 15 2007

name: Double factorials n!!: a(n) = n*a(n-2) for n > 1, a(0) = a(1) = 1.
Triangle read by rows of Stirling numbers of first kind, s(n,k), n >= 1, 1 <= k <= n.
formula: The unsigned numbers a(n, k)=|s(n, k)| satisfy a(n, k) = a(n-1, k-1) + (n-1)*a(n-1, k), n, k >= 1; a(n, 0) = a(0, k) = 0; a(0, 0) = 1.
